assertions.subject: Thrombocytopenia
assertions.quote: Moderate thrombocytopenia (50,000-100,000/µL) may manifest symptoms, eg, easy bruising

assertions.subject: Thrombocytopenia
assertions.quote: Severe thrombocytopenia (below 50,000/µL) can lead to bleeding during surgical procedures

assertions.subject: Thrombocytopenia
assertions.quote: individuals with platelet counts under 10,000/µL are more susceptible to spontaneous hemorrhage

assertions.subject: Thrombocytopenia
assertions.comparator: heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT), antiphospholipid antibody syndrome (APS), disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC), thrombotic microangiopathy, and paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH)
assertions.quote: thrombocytopenia may coexist with thrombotic events in conditions including heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT), antiphospholipid antibody syndrome (APS), disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC), thrombotic microangiopathy, and paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH)

assertions.subject: Primary immune thrombocytopenia (ITP)
assertions.quote: Primary immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) represents an autoimmune disorder

assertions.subject: Drug-induced ITP
assertions.quote: Drug-induced ITP includes reactions to medications

assertions.subject: Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT)
assertions.quote: HIT involves antiplatelet antibodies that activate platelets, resulting in arterial and venous thrombosis
